homeAddBody: Take a photo of your plant and Broto fills in its care. You can also add it without a photo.
homeTabsBody: Tap to switch, or swipe the screen sideways.
homeAnalyzeBody: One photo tells you the species, what is wrong and what to do.
homeChatBody: He knows your plants and answers about watering, light, pests and pots.
homeBellBody: When a plant needs you, the reminder is also kept here.
plantTodayBody: Mark what you did. The next date adjusts on its own.
plantCareBody: Tap a care task to change how often it happens and when you are reminded.
plantMenuBody: Edit, change the photo, analyse again or archive the plant.
resultCausesBody: From the most likely cause to the least. Swipe to see the others.
resultConfirmBody: A simple test to tell one cause from another before touching the plant.
resultSaveBody: It gets care reminders and keeps the history of its analyses.
cameraTipsBody: See how to frame leaves, stem and light so Broto gets the species right.
cameraGalleryBody: Pick one from your gallery. It works the same way.
